rule: Declare causal observation timeframe and intended prediction/holding horizon.
Estimate move on an explicitly frozen horizon matching the candidate decision horizon.
Compare round-trip cost with expected move on the same economic horizon; one-hour ATR cannot proxy a multi-day expected move without a preregistered horizon transform.
Exit cadence and maximum holding assumptions must be compatible with the signal horizon.
Any reused RD05-RD09 predictive label/proxy retains its original horizon semantics until explicitly reconciled.
